title: F001 rescope: DontPanic subtree mirror only; upstream sync operator-handled
body: F001 preflight surfaced a scope ambiguity that the v4 plan-doctor missed: original step language asked the implementer to bump agent-conventions/VERSION + commit upstream + subtree-pull, but the implementer worktree is scoped to /Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic and cannot reach /Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/agent-conventions/. The v4 F001 plan-doctor path-token regex `[\w./-]+\.\w+` misses extensionless tokens like `agent-conventions/VERSION`, so this slipped through lock-time validation. RESCOPE: implementer edits ONLY DontPanic subtree mirror at claude/shared/ (audit.schema.json + VERSION + CHANGELOG.md + Pydantic mirror at models/) + supervisor.py + tests. Operator handles upstream agent-conventions push out-of-band after F001 closes (cherry-pick changes into agent-conventions, tag v1.8.0, push). Step 8 added: explicit do-not-touch warning. Acceptance #8 added: no edits attempted outside DontPanic. v4.x candidate (doctor enhancement): widen path-token regex to catch extensionless filenames (VERSION, Makefile, Dockerfile, etc.) + scan plan.md narrative not just features.json steps.

title: F001 close-out (environmental_reproduction_failure) + v4.x candidate: iter0-blocked-with-advisory-only short-circuit
body: iter0 implementer signed off cleanly (2.59M tokens). Local verification: schema parsing-enum addition + Pydantic mirror + VERSION 1.8.0 + CHANGELOG + supervisor.py parse-warning sites flipped + tests updated + 1928 sweep green + sanitization clean. iter0 auditor returned audit_status=blocked because its sandbox couldn't run pytest — sole finding is advisory/test_coverage with recommendation to re-run in writable shell. Classic environmental_reproduction_failure shape. Operator close-out via dontpanic close --operator-resolved --reason environmental_reproduction_failure --allow-missing-breaker (--allow-missing-breaker required because terminal was 'blocked after 1 round', not 'stopped_no_progress' — close CLI safety check assumed the latter). v4.x CANDIDATE: v4 F003's ENVIRONMENTAL_BLOCKER short-circuit fires when verdict=blocked AND findings=[] (empty), promoting to stopped_environmental_blocker. v4 F002's reconciliation logic only fires post-no_progress threshold. Neither handles the common iter0 case of 'verdict=blocked AND all findings classify as advisory/environmental per F003 taxonomy'. Should extend the F003 short-circuit (or v4 F002 reconciliation) to fire from finding-class classification on the first blocked iter, not just empty findings. Would have auto-promoted this volley to stopped_environmental_blocker, sparing the operator-resolved CLI invocation. Logged as carry for a future v4.x/v5 plan.
